precepts.text: The house of Stephanas addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints; studying in your alone time should become an addiction, a righteous addiction that replaces idleness.
precepts.point: Who can understand his errors? Cleanse thou me from secret faults. This should be your reason to be in this walk, not to appear righteous, but because God shall bring every work into judgment; work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
Paul commends the house of Stephanas, “that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints”. They addicted themselves to the ministry.

Studying in your alone time should become an addiction like that, a righteous addiction that replaces idleness. That is how you work at being cleansed from secret faults.

The souls of men and women who have dedicated themselves to this truth are the firstfruits. “Ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints”. Not addicted to weed, crack cocaine, porn, gluttony or video games: the only thing we are to be addicted to is the ministry of the saints.

precepts.why: “The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.” So they obviously had churches in Asia, churches of Asia Minor. There were churches built up by the time Paul had written this letter.

moments.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: I beseech you, brethren, ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves. They have what? Addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints.

You see that? That is what we do here. We are addicted. Those that are actually in the fight, it is not grudging for you to learn the Bible. When you addict yourself to the Bible, it is no problem. You can listen to the word of God all day and night. But you are going to have people like this amongst us that come, then leave. It is what it is. We know we can see who is real and who is not. It is easy to be seen.
The clip continues: camp is a cult. And I was in this cult for a few months and I was trying to move up in the ranks.

So why was he here? He was here for rank. Partly he could not show up three times a week. Now it is a cult because you ain't the grand poobah in the school, because we have rank order instruction, because we have things in place, because we know everybody is trying to infiltrate this organisation right here. They ain't worrying about no other camp. They are going to worry about this right here.

Guess what? For you to infiltrate IUIC, you are going to learn the Bible. You are going to prove that you believe what you teach. Because you are not coming in here and becoming the chairman after two weeks, like in the Black Panthers. It ain't happening. And those NFAC and New Black Panther Party and FBA — yeah, go be the leader of those organisations. Not this. This ain't set up by men. This is set up by God.

This is what a lot of brothers and sisters do not want to do. And you know what is funny? When you come into the truth, you do not worry about rank. I remember the first time I talked to somebody like, he is an officer — like, what is that? I do not know what that is. I knew what a deacon was, you had a deacon in the church. I knew what a bishop was. But officer, soldier? Okay, cool. Nobody cared about that. The brothers that are captains now, we did not care about that. That is not why you are here. You are here to save your people. That is why you should be here.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Let all your things be done with charity. Quit you like men means conduct yourself like a man: keeping the commandments, with maturity, courage, discipline, and responsibility. That is how you have to deal as a man, and that is how you have to deal with your wife in your household.
